name: NEVERMORE
source:
"Merry Christmas and Happy Birthday,
Make a wish! 
I pray thee alive happily ever after.
However, oh how I beseech, don't ever forget, 
to never wish upon stars foreordained unattainable."

Prior to the final Christmas descending premillennial, December 13, 1999, in a green train, the slanting sunset hits his face, awakening him back to reality. The susurrations of the whispering girl in his dreams gradually fades in his heart, leaving naught but his long deserted, desolate life recorded in the diary book he had carried with him.
As the last of the trailing wheels halt their voices, the time is evening, in the wake of memories that oughtn't exist, after a three-year truancy, Cheng Feng had returned to his hometown——Town Mo.

So a new life begins. A life presumed to be dull and colourless, shortly becomes heartfelt as he opens his heart to the smiling people he meets. Yet at the same time, the world around him gradually moves towards an unpredictable, dubious future in those days and nights.
As he faces those memories everlasting from three years ago and the people who perpetually remain within, the actuality of it all luminated verity. The ending had already been set in point from the genesises of these reminiscing episodes, as these choices were all his wishes.

The ultimate Christmas of the millennium awaits its advent, gazing blankly at the blazing sunset on the horizon. Anon, the promise made by the lone person under the solitary sky had already been engraved in such sad colours.
"God is dead in the fire of heaven."——Thenceforth Milan Kundera's words, everything was already over.
translation:
“圣诞快乐，生日快乐，
许个愿吧！
我祈祷你永远幸福快乐。
然而，哦，我多么恳求，永远不要忘记，
永远不要向注定无法实现的星星许愿。”

1999年12月13日，在前千禧年的最后一个圣诞节到来之前，在绿色的火车上，斜斜的夕阳打在他的脸上，把他惊醒回现实。梦中那个窃窃私语的女孩的呢喃声在他心中逐渐消失，只剩下他随身携带的日记本上记录的他长久以来荒凉而荒凉的生活。
当最后一个后轮停下声音时，时间已是傍晚，在不该存在的记忆中，逃学三年的程枫回到了家乡——莫镇。

于是新的生活开始了。当他向遇到的微笑的人敞开心扉时，原本以为平淡无奇的生活很快就会变得真诚。但与此同时，他周围的世界也在那些日日夜夜中逐渐走向不可预知、扑朔迷离的未来。
当他面对三年前那些永恒的记忆和永远留在里面的人时，一切的现实都变得真实起来。结局从这些回忆开始就已经注定了，因为这些选择都是他的愿望。

千禧年终极圣诞节正等待着它的到来，茫然地凝视着地平线上炽热的夕阳。不知何时，孤独的天空下，一个人许下的诺言，已经被刻上了如此悲伤的色彩。
“上帝死在天堂之火中。”——米兰·昆德拉的话，一切都已经结束了。
